impact_pathways.expected_impact_description: Improved researcher employability and career mobility within and beyond academia, contributing to a more dynamic and flexible research talent base in Europe.

outcomes.statement: A researcher profile combining biological understanding, scalable geospatial prediction and operational decision support, carried by an agreed and reviewed Career Development Plan.

impact_pathways.impact_narrative: The Career Development Plan (D1.3), agreed by M3 and reviewed at the five steering points (M6, M12, M16, M20, M27), operationalises the fellow's progression into an interdisciplinary profile that fuses plant-physiology understanding, scalable Sentinel-based geospatial prediction and operational decision support. Combined with the non-academic AgroVIR placement, which adds a documented inter-sectoral period, this pathway improves the fellow's employability and mobility within academia and beyond, feeding the broader European research talent base.

impact_pathways.expected_impact_description: Enriched European R&I culture through the spread of international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary approaches and mind-sets, diversifying research methods and cross-boundary knowledge flows.

outcomes.statement: Quantified temporal and Hungary-to-Bulgaria transferability of the predictive model, with a stated local-calibration cost for adapting it to a new agro-environment.
Evidence of field-level decision value under commercial farming conditions, enabling model selection by usefulness rather than retrospective accuracy.

impact_pathways.impact_narrative: The Hungary-to-Bulgaria transferability report (D4.2), produced with MVCRI, supplies the international dimension; the AgroVIR functional/technical evaluation (D5.4) and the associated commercial placement supply the inter-sectoral dimension; and the two-way exchange between plant physiology and geoinformatics running through the project supplies the interdisciplinary dimension. Together these spread international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary mind-sets and cross-boundary knowledge flows into the European R&I culture.

impact_pathways.impact_narrative: No Phase 3 deliverable currently realises this expected impact. Tier 3 records an operator-decided activity measure — one public field demonstration with AgroVIR farmers and one public-facing article per year — that carries no deliverable id, because no deliverable in the WP structure covers it and inventing one would fabricate a project fact (CLAUDE.md §13.3). Flagged as uncovered by a named WP deliverable; Phase 3 owns the deliverable list and may add a dissemination deliverable that a later revision of this pathway can bind.

impact_pathways.expected_impact_description: A more equitable and attractive European research environment through the progressive alignment of researcher working conditions with the European Charter for Researchers principles across participating organisations.

outcomes.statement: A researcher profile combining biological understanding, scalable geospatial prediction and operational decision support, carried by an agreed and reviewed Career Development Plan.

impact_pathways.impact_narrative: Alignment with the European Charter for Researchers is evidenced at instrument level by the Career Development Plan (D1.3), by ELTE's open recruitment and researcher-development policies, and by the supervision and training arrangements the project establishes. This is the thinnest of the six mappings — it rests on D1.3, institutional policy and the supervision arrangements, with no external accreditation, and no HRS4R claim is made (ELTE does not hold the HR Excellence in Research award).

impact_pathways.expected_impact_description: Strengthened European R&I competitiveness and global standing through the increased attractiveness, stronger knowledge output, and improved knowledge transfer capacity of participating research organisations.

outcomes.statement: A physiologically defined water-stress target and a Sentinel-2-transferable early-warning feature basis, replacing spectral-proxy stress definitions.
A prospective, uncertainty-aware stress-forecasting capability at actionable horizons, in place of static detection.
Quantified temporal and Hungary-to-Bulgaria transferability of the predictive model, with a stated local-calibration cost for adapting it to a new agro-environment.

impact_pathways.impact_narrative: The hyperspectral-to-Sentinel transfer library (D2.2), the released FIELDWISE predictive engine with its model card (D3.2), and the adaptation protocol (D4.3) constitute reusable, documented R&I outputs that raise the knowledge output and transfer capacity of the participating organisations (ELTE, MATE, MVCRI, AgroVIR). Together with the two-way transfer between the fellow and ELTE, this pathway strengthens European R&I capacity, output and knowledge transfer among European research organisations.

impact_pathways.impact_narrative: No Phase 3 deliverable currently realises this expected impact. Tier 3 records an operator-decided teaching measure — co-design and delivery of a full module unit within an ELTE MSc course on Earth observation for agriculture, primary supervision of one ELTE MSc thesis, and co-supervision of the field-experiment component of one PhD student's work — that carries no deliverable id. kpis.description: Career Development Plan agreed and reviewed at all steering points.
kpis.target: Career Development Plan agreed by M3 and reviewed at all five steering points (M6, M12, M16, M20, M27).
kpis.measurement_method: Verification that the D1.3 Career Development Plan is signed by M3 and that dated review records exist at each of the five steering points.

kpis.target: Zero-shot and locally calibrated Hungary-to-Bulgaria performance both reported.
kpis.measurement_method: Comparison of reported zero-shot versus locally calibrated model performance in the D4.2 transferability report.

kpis.target: The AgroVIR report covers all nine assessment dimensions listed in §1.2.
kpis.measurement_method: Checklist verification that the D5.4 AgroVIR functional/technical evaluation addresses each of the nine assessment dimensions.

kpis.target: Every candidate hyperspectral feature carries an explicit transferable or hyperspectral-only verdict.
kpis.measurement_method: Audit of the D2.2 transfer library confirming each candidate feature has a recorded transferability verdict.

kpis.target: One model card published for the released predictive engine.
kpis.measurement_method: Confirmation that a published model card accompanies the D3.2 released predictive engine.

kpis.target: The adaptation protocol states the minimum local calibration volume needed.
kpis.measurement_method: Verification that the D4.3 adaptation protocol states the minimum local calibration volume required for a new agro-environment.

activities.timing: Ongoing from M6, with major results published M18-M27 (open access)

activities.target_audience: Commercial processing-tomato growers and farm agronomists in the AgroVIR client base (Hungary and the Bulgaria transfer region)
activities.timing: One demonstration in the placement period, around M20-M24

activities.activity_type: One public-facing article per year in agricultural trade / extension press explaining irrigation-timing decision support (operator-decided EI-03 measure)
activities.target_audience: Irrigated-horticulture growers, agricultural advisory services and farm-water managers

activities.activity_type: Integration of R&I results into teaching: co-designed module unit on Earth observation for agriculture and supervision of MSc/PhD student work (operator-decided EI-06 measure)

activities.activity_type: Publication of the released predictive engine's model card and, where FAIR-compatible, the hyperspectral-to-Sentinel transfer library and adaptation protocol
activities.target_audience: European research organisations and agri-tech developers seeking reusable crop-stress prediction methods (ELTE, MATE, MVCRI, AgroVIR and the wider community)
activities.timing: At release of D3.2/D2.2/D4.3, approximately M18-M27

dissemination_plan.open_access_policy: FIELDWISE follows Horizon Europe / MSCA open-science requirements: a Data Management Plan is delivered as a distinct deliverable by month 6, research data is made findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable (FAIR), and peer-reviewed publications are made open access. The released predictive engine (D3.2) is accompanied by a published model card, and the harmonised archive metadata (D1.1), transfer library (D2.2) and adaptation protocol (D4.3) are shared openly to the extent that partner data-sharing agreements with MVCRI and AgroVIR permit.

activities.activity_type: Advance the desktop research prototype to a scientifically validated web MVP serving stress probability, uncertainty, spatial risk, irrigation priority and temporal evolution (D5.1)
activities.expected_result: A reachable, evaluated web MVP demonstrating operational decision value for irrigation timing under commercial farming conditions

activities.activity_type: External AgroVIR functional/technical evaluation (D5.4) and definition of an FMIS integration roadmap (D5.5)
activities.expected_result: Evidence on whether the technology meets real agricultural-software requirements and a named path (interfaces + post-fellowship steps) to integrate FIELDWISE into a commercial farm management information system

activities.activity_type: Release of the predictive engine with its model card (D3.2), the hyperspectral-to-Sentinel transfer library (D2.2) and the adaptation protocol (D4.3) for reuse in new agro-environments
activities.expected_result: Reusable, documented R&I outputs enabling other European research organisations to adopt and locally recalibrate the method, with the stated minimum local-calibration cost
Quantified zero-shot and locally calibrated transfer performance establishing the basis for reuse of the model beyond its training region

exploitation_plan.ipr_strategy: No explicit IPR arrangements are recorded in Tier 3. As a default position, background remains with each originating partner; project foreground (the predictive engine, transfer library and adaptation protocol) is released openly with a model card to maximise scientific reuse and knowledge transfer, while AgroVIR's commercial exploitation via FMIS integration (D5.5) proceeds under a partner agreement to be concluded. Formal IPR terms are to be confirmed and are not fabricated here.

sustainability_mechanism.description: Results persist beyond the fellowship through several channels: the released predictive engine and its published model card (D3.2) remain available and documented for continued research use; the adaptation protocol (D4.3) states the minimum local-calibration volume needed, allowing the method to be reused and recalibrated in new agro-environments; the hyperspectral-to-Sentinel transfer library (D2.2) preserves the transferable feature basis for future Sentinel-based work; and the FMIS integration roadmap (D5.5), together with the AgroVIR evaluation (D5.4), defines the concrete post-fellowship steps toward commercial uptake. The interdisciplinary researcher profile carried by the reviewed Career Development Plan (D1.3), and the integration of results into ELTE teaching, sustain the human and institutional capacity created by the project.
